items.title: The softest coat
items.text: Sea otters have the densest fur of any animal: up to 150,000 hairs in every square centimetre.

footage.title: In the center of a light blue ocean, an adult sea otter is captured in a playful moment, lying on its back with its arms and legs spread out in front of it. The otter's fur is a mix of brown and gray shades, blending harmoniously with the surrounding water. Its head is slightly tilted to the left as if it's about to dive into the ocean or simply enjoying the cool water around it.
